prevention.name: Prevention
prevention.source: 前身 33 份守則 · 由 checker 候選降級落嚟
prevention.why:
Legacy Prevention view. Questions resolve from their current owners; this view is not dispatched again by normal sweeps. Existing claim IDs remain in the prevention namespace.

Review guidance, not an enforced checker or proof of review completion. Apply each question to this repo’s actual scope and architecture; state when it does not apply. Source names and R-/PL- identifiers are historical attribution, not required files in the adopter. Historical measurements below describe the recorded experiment, not a new measurement.

每一條都曾經被判「做得到 checker」,然後喺對抗核(要求提出真實 red 同 green)度企唔住。**企唔住唔等於規則假**,而四個理由要分開睇 —— 每條 check 帶住佢自己嗰個。
最重要嗰個係「今日冇實例」:一條預防規則喺一個健康 repo 度應該就係揾唔到嘢。用「冇發生過」去否證一個防禦,就係 Wald 嗰架轟炸機 —— 你數緊飛得返嚟嗰啲。
放喺 lens 唔放喺 checker,因為 reviewer 睇住一個 diff 判得到,而一個 checker 對住成個 repo 會誤報。
